hero.title: Join our care team
hero.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself, it takes about 5 minutes.

apply.pageSubtitle: Join our network of verified home nurses and caregivers across India.

step1.title: Personal Details
step1.phoneHint: We will send shift and interview updates here

step2.title: Qualifications & Skills
step2.councilHint: Applicable for GNM, ANM, and B.Sc Nursing graduates
step2.skillsHint: Select all clinical and care services you provide
step2.languagesHint: Languages you can comfortably speak with patient families
step2.workNotePlaceholder: Brief note on hospitals, clinics, or home care cases you handled (Optional)

step3.title: Cities & Availability
step3.preferredCitiesHint: Locations where you can take care assignments

step4.title: Document Upload
step4.desc: Upload ID proof, photo, and certificates
step4.idProofDesc: Aadhaar (masked recommended), Voter ID, or Passport (max 5 MB)
step4.photoDesc: Recent photo with clear face visibility (max 5 MB)
step4.certsDesc: Degree, diploma, or caregiving certificates (1 to 5 files, max 5 MB each)

step5.title: Review & Consent
step5.desc: Confirm details and complete security check
step5.consentText: I confirm that all provided details and credentials are true and accurate. I consent to TheCarePal verifying my background and qualifications.
step5.turnstileNote: Please complete the verification check before submitting.

success.title: Application Received!
success.subtitle: Thank you for applying to TheCarePal care network.
success.step1: Our clinical operations team reviews your qualifications within 2-3 business days.
success.step2: Shortlisted candidates receive an invitation to book a clinical interview slot.
success.step3: Following verification, onboarded care staff receive identity badges and shift assignments.
